description: This file defines the AppUserRepository interface, which extends multiple Spring Data repository interfaces and includes custom query methods for accessing AppUser entities within the application. It serves as a data access layer component for user-related data.

classes.name: AppUserRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface for accessing AppUser entities, with custom query methods for retrieving user information by username and office ID.

methods.name: findAppUserByName
methods.description: Retrieves an AppUser entity based on the provided username parameter using a custom JPQL query.

methods.name: findByOfficeId
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of AppUser entities that are associated with the specified office ID.
